newsitem.title: USA: Reliance to acquire Siskin Steel for $71 mln.
newsitem.headline: Reliance to acquire Siskin Steel for $71 mln.

text.p: Reliance Steel & Aluminum Co said on Monday that it has agreed to acquire Siskin Steel & Supply Co Inc, a privately held metals service company based in Chattanooga, Tenn., for $71 million in cash.
The deal is expected to be completed by Oct. 10, 1996. Details of the transaction were undisclosed.

Siskin's revenues for the fiscal year ended June 30, 1996, were approximately $151 million. Most of its operations involve the processing and sale of carbon steel products such as plate, bars, structurals, pipe and tubing. It also has a growing presence in stainless steel, alloy and aluminum.
Siskin will become a wholly owned unit of Reliance. Its current management will remain in place and continue to operate the business, Reliance said in a statement.
